diagnosis.description: Demand surge outpaces available shelf stock prior to the next scheduled truck arrival.
diagnosis.root_cause: India vs Pakistan T20 Final starts at 19:30, multiplying hourly demand by 3.0x (from 3.0 to 9.0 units/hr).

primary.title: Clear Slow Snack Slot & Transfer 10 Units from Store 9

fallback.title: Pull Scheduled Truck TRUCK_NORTH_101 Forward by 45 Minutes
fallback.reason_why_not_primary: Costs ₹23 more than local transfer and consumes 20 units of scheduled warehouse delivery capacity.

agent_explanation.summary: Store 7 runs out of FizzCola 750ml at 20:13, 47 minutes before truck arrival. Clear slow snack slot, then transfer 10 bottles from Store 9. Net margin protected: ₹72.50.
chain_of_thought: Observed: 14 units in stock. Baseline demand = 3/hr. Match uplift starting 19:30 raises demand to 9/hr.
Diagnosed: Stock runs out at 20:13. Scheduled truck arrives at 21:00. Exposure window = 47 minutes, projecting 7 lost sales (₹94.50 lost margin).
Evaluated Option 1 (Transfer): Store 9 has 60 bottles, requires only 12 until its own truck. Surplus of 48 bottles allows a safe 10-bottle donation.
Evaluated Option 2 (Shelf Swap): Shelf slot has only 11 units free capacity. Freeing adjacent slot SLOT_SNACK_B2 creates safe overhead.
Evaluated Option 3 (Early Truck): Truck TRUCK_NORTH_101 can be advanced by 45 minutes, but net margin is ₹49.50 vs ₹72.50 for transfer.
Critic Verification: Transit ETA (32 min) easily arrives prior to 20:13 stockout. No donor stockout created.
Decision: Recommend Option 1 (Swap + Transfer) with Option 3 (Early Truck) as instant fallback.

diagnosis.description: Delivery fleet capacity is exhausted; stock is plentiful on the shelf.
diagnosis.root_cause: Only 1 rider available between 19:00-21:00 (max 2.5 drops/hr) while order volume is 8.0 orders/hr.

primary.title: Escalate 2 Flex Delivery Riders to Store 3 (Do Not Transfer Stock)
primary.reasoning: Do not move inventory! Store 3 has 78 units on shelf. The bottleneck is dispatch bandwidth, not shelf inventory.

fallback.title: Cap In-App Promotional Visibility for Store 3 Delivery Radius
fallback.reason_why_not_primary: Sacrifices GMV. Rider escalation preserves customer fulfillment.

agent_explanation.summary: Store 3 has 78 units on shelf but only 1 rider active. Moving stock will not help. Escalate 2 flex riders immediately.
chain_of_thought: Observed: Stock level is healthy (78 units). Next truck is 22:30.
Diagnosed: Rider count = 1. Dispatch limit = 2.5 drops/hr. Order intake = 8/hr.
Bottleneck Gate: Classify as RIDER_SHORTAGE. Moving physical stock generates zero incremental sales.
Decision: Propose rider dispatch surge. Avoid wasteful stock transfer logistics.
